spans.s:
kauśa, a. 1. silken (coming from the 🞄cocoon: kośa);
 2. á, (ī) made of Kuśa grass.
kauśāmbī, f. N. of a city: -ya, a. 🞄belonging to Kauśāmbī.

kauśīlav-a, n. profession of a bard 🞄or actor;
 -ya, n. id..

kauṣītaka, ˚कि -ki, m. pat. from 🞄Kuṣītaka: (ki) -brāhmaṇa, n. Brāhmaṇa 🞄of the Kauṣītakins (also called Śāṅkhāyana 🞄Brāhmaṇa);
 (ki) -upaniṣad, f. Kauṣītaki-upaniṣad.

kausuma, a. coming from or made 🞄of flowers;
 -āyudha, a. relating to Kāma.

kausumbha, a. (ī) coming from, 🞄coloured with or like safflower;
 n. substance 🞄coloured with safflower.

kaustubha, m. n. jewel produced at 🞄the churning of the ocean, an ornament of 🞄Viṣṇu;
 -bhṛt, m. ep. of Viṣṇu.
